title: Passing the bound ofReal|X_ε(h)| ≤ ofReal((1+ε)/h)·LW·a(h) to the liminf as h → 0+ and then letting ε ↓ 0, in [0,∞] (parent Steps 5–6)
statement: Let a : ℝ → [0,∞], LW ∈ ℝ≥0 and r ∈ ℝ, and write ofReal(x) := max(x, 0) ∈ [0,∞] for x ∈ ℝ (ENNReal.ofReal). Suppose that for every ε > 0 there is X : ℝ → ℝ with X(h) → r as h → 0+ (along 𝓝[>] 0) and ofReal|X(h)| ≤ ofReal((1+ε)/h)·LW·a(h) for every h > 0 (products in [0,∞]). Then ofReal|r| ≤ LW·liminf_{h→0+} a(h)/ofReal(h) in [0,∞], with 0·∞ = 0 and the liminf taken along 𝓝[>] 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (LW : ℝ≥0) (r : ℝ), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto X (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 r) ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ENNReal.ofReal |X h| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) / h) * (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * a h) → ENNReal.ofReal |r| ≤ (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => a h / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0)
